notes: New Cast button for live TV and compatible videos on supported Google Cast and DLNA TVs. Improved live-stream audio and video timing compatibility, tested on Samsung TV and NVIDIA Shield. Casting starts without a controls popup; tap the phone video for Play/pause, Stop casting, and Change TV. No pairing or extra receiver app on supported TVs. Keep the phone/tablet on Wi-Fi while it relays a stream. Includes clearer outlined buttons and spacing. Includes an automatic built-in local/USB recording-storage chooser for Fire TV devices without a folder picker.
